thread:
anna_support: FYI — Northline Logistics (Enterprise) reporting autopay failure on monthly invoice. multiple retries all declined, customer insists funds available. tagging @marcus_billing for billing context
marcus_billing: Thanks. Do we have a payment_id or gateway response? autopay or manual retry? :eyes:
anna_support: Autopay. payment_id `pay_8a2f9b`. customer pasted webhook payload, pasted below. they said a 3DS prompt appeared then timed out.
anna_support: ```json
{
  "payment_id": "pay_8a2f9b",
  "status": "failed",
  "decline_code": "insufficient_funds",
  "acquirer_response": "3DS_CHALLENGE_REQUIRED",
  "acs": "challenge_required",
  "correlation_id": "corr_20250301_42",
  "last_attempt": {
    "attempted_at": "2025-03-01T15:24:10Z",
    "challenge_timeout_seconds": 30,
    "user_action": "no_response"
  }
}
```
priya_engineer: @anna_support can you paste the x-request-id / gateway headers from the failing request? need to match logs. also, which 3DS flow is enabled (iframe vs redirect)? some merchants block iframes via CSP.
anna_support: headers: `x-request-id: r-9b1f`, `x-correlation-id: corr_20250301_42`. northline uses iframe 3DS in their portal.
james_payments: gateway trace for corr_20250301_42 shows acquirer -> challenge_required then ACS never completed the challenge. gateway marked `challenge_window_expired`. downstream second attempt mapped to `insufficient_funds`. sequence indicates both events.
priya_engineer: repro logs show iframe load returned 403 from ACS endpoint in that window. likely CSP/frame-ancestors or same-site cookie blocking. snippet:
```
[2025-03-01T15:24:05Z] iframe_loader.js: GET https://acs.acquirer.example/challenge 403
[2025-03-01T15:24:06Z] 3ds_flow: challenge_attempted, window_opened
[2025-03-01T15:24:40Z] 3ds_flow: challenge_timeout -> user_no_action
```
marcus_billing: if iframe blocked & user never completes, acquirer can re-evaluate and later return insufficient_funds on retry. merchant is on autopay with 3 retries every 24h. customer says card usually works — could be transient. ops: any pattern of iframe blocks for Northline? @james_payments
james_payments: historically none. recent CSP change on their portal added stricter frame-ancestors which blocks third-party ACS iframes. i reproduced loading portal with that CSP header and saw ACS iframe blocked.
anna_support: customer asking for short-term workaround to clear invoice today — service may be cut off. what can we do immediately?
priya_engineer: short-term options:
- ask payer to retry via hosted payment page (redirect) — bypasses iframe and completes ACS.
- process one-off manual charge using saved card (if merchant allows) to force auth outside autopay window.
- increase retry cadence temporarily so next attempt is sooner. we can't extend ACS challenge timeout from our side.
james_payments: recommend temporarily flip merchant to redirect 3DS until CSP is patched. i'll open a quick merchant-config change with safe rollback.
anna_support: can you confirm decline label `insufficient_funds` is accurate or just our mapping masking root cause?
james_payments: confirmed. sequence: acquirer -> challenge_required -> challenge_timeout (user no action) -> subsequent auth attempt -> insufficient_funds. immediate autopay failure was challenge timeout; later return was insufficient funds.
marcus_billing: i'll file a billing exception to pause dunning for today and shorten retry window while we fix CSP. ticket BL-3284 created.
priya_engineer: action items:
1) james_payments — flip merchant 3DS to redirect (temp). ETA ~1h.
2) marcus_billing — set billing exception + adjust retry cadence. ETA ~30m.
3) anna_support — email Northline with hosted retry instructions and CSP guidance (include diagnostics). i'll draft.
4) priya_engineer — continue log monitoring to ensure no further iframe blocks (ETA EOD).
payments-bot: deployment queued: deploy_merchant_cfg_redirect_3ds -> env:prod (merchant r-9b1f)
anna_support: holding outreach until BL-3284 confirmed. :thumbsup:
james_payments: update — merchant config flipped to redirect 3DS in prod (correlation r-9b1f). monitoring next attempts.
anna_support: customer retried via hosted page (redirect) and payment succeeded. invoice cleared, customer confirmed. marking pending until billing exception completes.
marcus_billing: BL-3284 completed, dunning paused, closing from billing. :white_check_mark:
priya_engineer: logs show no further iframe 403s in last 24h. closing log item.
anna_support: great. closing thread. recommendation: add support KB "ACS iframe blocked -> switch to redirect flow" and include quick repro steps and copyable CSP diagnostics for merchants.
